namespace ThetaEquiv193Isolated
#check_failure Roth.Θ_equiv
#check @congrArg
#check @sSup_image
#check @sSup_image'
#check @Equiv.iSup_congr
theorem law {α : Type*} [SupSet α] {s t : Set α} (h : s = t) : sSup s = sSup t :=
  congrArg sSup h
theorem reindex {α ι κ : Type*} [SupSet α] (e : ι ≃ κ) (f : ι → α) (g : κ → α)
    (h : ∀ i, g (e i) = f i) : iSup f = iSup g := e.iSup_congr h
#print axioms law
#print axioms reindex
end ThetaEquiv193Isolated
